topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I've been thinking about the old times, digging through my memories like treasure, trying to pass the time. I reached out to my childhood best friend today, the one we did everything with. But when I called, there was this long pause, and then, "I'm sorry, I don't remember you." It's like all the pieces of a puzzle I thought I knew suddenly don’t fit. I tried to jog their memory, a few more details, but it was clear the connection was one-sided. I guess some things just get lost over time, no matter how much they mean to you.
